_comment: ENGAGEMENT DAY template — a single-day campaign config for scripts/postprocess_report.py: one engagements[] entry per flight at its best realistic pass (engagement_tab format: summary → Overview (ground tracks + CPA timing) → [Seeker FOV player] → 3-D → top-down → closing distance → closing speed → heading error → track metrics → state table). scripts/quicklook_report.py fills every <PLACEHOLDER> from flights.json + meta.json. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the code; never put one inside a fixed-length list row (window_pdt pair, ant triple). Numeric placeholders MUST become numbers. Build: cd scripts && micromamba run -n sensorenv python postprocess_report.py <this file>.

_comment_placeholders.<DAY>: YYYY-MM-DD (day id MUST be a date; all clock strings resolve on it with the fixed UTC-7 converter). AUTO: --day
_comment_placeholders.<RUN8>: first 8 hex of the run. AUTO: meta.json run_id8 / run, else flights.json runs[0].run
_comment_placeholders.<MRU>: unit number for the sub-line. AUTO: meta.json mru when present
_comment_placeholders.<DUMP_DIR>: the dump dir that holds THIS flight's window (tracks/track_<TRACK_ID>.csv must exist there). AUTO: the --dumps entry containing the track file and covering the pass
_comment_placeholders.<INTERCEPTOR_PATTERN>: interceptor truth glob under <DUMP_DIR>/mavlink/, several compids merged, e.g. mav14551_2_*.csv. AUTO: --interceptor, else derived from the mavlink/ file names (alias-broken 'mavlink_*' files excluded)
_comment_placeholders.<TARGET_PATTERN>: target truth csv, e.g. mav14550_1_1.csv. AUTO: --target, else flights.json tracking.target + .csv
_comment_placeholders.<HH:MM:SS>: PDT clock strings. AUTO: window_pdt from flights[].t0_pdt/t1_pdt, cpa_seed_pdt from the chosen passes[].t_pdt
_comment_placeholders.<TRACK_ID>: radar track riding the TARGET at the pass. AUTO: flights.json tracking.target_track_spans entry whose span contains the pass (smallest median offset wins), else a scan of <DUMP_DIR>/tracks/
_comment_placeholders.<HHMMSS>: cpa_seed_pdt without colons (gif file name). AUTO
_comment_placeholders.<ANT_LAT>,<ANT_LON>,<ANT_HAE_M>: THIS day's antenna origin (per deployment — never reuse another day's). AUTO: meta.json 'antenna' / 'antenna_origin_lat_lon_haeM' (or --ant)

title: Quick look — <DAY> (engagements)
sub: MRU<MRU> · run <RUN8> · quick-look build (auto-filled from flights.json; narratives pending)
_comment_server_base: '' = no link rewrite in Rollup_standalone.html; set to http://172.18.1.28:8899/<out_root basename> when served
_comment_rollup_html: NARRATIVE (analyst): the campaign in one arc

days._comment: ONE engagement day. One engagements[] entry per featured pass (quicklook: the best realistic pass of every flight that has one; flights without a realistic pass are skipped with a console note). Every clock string resolves on 'date'.
days.title: <M/D> — Engagements (<N> flights)
days._comment_ant: three numbers from THIS day's meta.json. AUTO
days._comment_overview_html: OPTIONAL NARRATIVE (analyst): non-empty adds a leading 'Overview' tab with this HTML (day-level story, passes table). '' -> no Overview tab. The per-engagement 'Overview — ground tracks & CPA timing' figure is automatic: it is computed from window_pdt (stars = realistic passes < 75 m, gold = best) — so window_pdt must be the WHOLE flight, not just the pass.

engagements.name: <M/D> Flight 1 — pass <N> (<HH:MM:SS> PDT)
engagements._comment_name: pane <h3> + 3-D/2-D figure titles; factual (flight, pass number, time). AUTO

target._comment: alternative when the MAVLink truth froze at the pass: {"traj_csv": "/abs/onboard_gps_traj.csv"} with columns utc_s,lat,lon,alt_hae_m (replaces 'pattern')

engagements._comment_cpa_seed_pdt: the pass time from flights.json passes[].t_pdt; eng_plots.cpa refines it within ±20 s (late-born track: ±120 s fallback for the track CPA). AUTO
engagements._comment_err_window: seconds before/after CPA for the 'Track metrics in this window' az/el/range/alt error panels (the CPA replay window itself is the binding t−10…t+5 s and is not configurable)
engagements.summary_html: Closest approach {cpa_truth:.0f} m truth-truth; {cpa_track:.0f} m to radar track {track_id}.
engagements._comment_summary_html: factual default — only {cpa_truth} {cpa_track} {track_id} are substituted (any other {brace} raises KeyError; write literal braces as {{ }}). Analyst: prepend the key message.
engagements._comment_post_html: NARRATIVE (analyst): HTML appended after the pane (steal/corruption notes for this pass)

_fov_example._comment: OPTIONAL Seeker FOV player — rename '_fov_example' to 'fov' ONLY when the interceptor ulog + IR video + measured clock offset exist (needs ffmpeg; missing inputs skip the section with a console note, never crash). zoff = flight-controller clock offset (s) from position xcorr vs truth (8/27: 36002.0; 8/28: 36001.3–36001.8). Camera time: EITHER cam{fps,onset_frame} (frame 0 anchored to the ulog takeoff) OR camwarp npz of per-frame capture times.

days._comment_key_message_html: NARRATIVE (analyst): rollup card column 2, e.g. 'Much better engagements — and track steals: 3 track steals at the crossings'
days._comment_numbers_html:
rollup card column 3, labelled line-per-metric ('Best CPA: 21 m (truth-truth)
Passes <75 m: 10 of 23
Track steals: 3'). AUTO from flights.json passes/steal_events — verify before publishing

_comment_radar_rollup: OPTIONAL Radar Rollup tab, off in a quick look (absent key = no tab). Rename '_radar_rollup_disabled' to 'radar_rollup' (quicklook: --radar-rollup) to compute az-bias bars, turn statistics and the heat map from the dump dirs; add steal_views/corruption_views only for events with a run id, track id and PDT time. Target csv must match mavlink/mav14550*.csv.
